overall_summary: Data volume is low, leading to low confidence. However, a clear outlier exists: family and core relationship relationship dynamics (specifically husband-wife and general communication like 'रिश्ते खत्म नहीं होते') outperform niche topics. The top video reached 1,658 views ('पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए'), indicating strong resonance with interpersonal relationship realizations.

winning_patterns.evidence: Video 'or5gtaBpRVY' about husband-wife dynamics got 1,658 views, significantly outperforming others.
winning_patterns.action: Focus more heavily on relatable partner and relationship misunderstandings.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos addressing unspoken feelings in relationships ('रिश्ते खत्म नहीं होते, बात बंद हो जाती है') and family ('माँ जब पूछती है') perform consistently better than niche ones.
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational, highly empathetic hooks targeting everyday relationship truths.

weak_patterns.evidence: Sister emotional video (jfmMztnam_A) dropped heavily to 18 views compared to broader family themes.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid hyper-specific sibling sub-niches temporarily; stick to broader relationship and romantic dynamics.
